description: Defines the CordzSampleToken class used for thread-safe traversal and cleanup of CordzInfo objects in the Abseil library.

classes.name: CordzSampleToken
classes.description: A class that provides thread-safe iteration over CordzInfo objects, ensuring safe cleanup and traversal without holding a mutex.

classes.name: CordzSampleToken::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing CordzInfo objects associated with a CordzSampleToken.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the CordzInfo list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the CordzInfo list.
